workingTreeState: final source frozen before root validation
scope: WP05 cross-goal dependency definition binding and live status projection
Fail-closed gating for native rounds, owner resume, scheduled wake, event wait and delayed completion
Restart recovery for dependency-bound prepared and scheduled wakes
implementation: Goal schema v3 freezes ordered dependency goal IDs with exact definition version and digest in the same owner-scoped checkpoint CAS transaction; duplicate, cross-scope, self and cyclic dependencies are rejected.
Schema v2 ID-only dependencies remain stale with reason legacy-unbound and require an explicit new owner checkpoint; a v2 database carrying impossible Host-only bindings is rejected.
The public projection has six states: achieved, pending, failed, unknown, cleared and stale. Only an exact independently achieved receipt plus native complete satisfies the gate.

Execution and wake intents persist ordered dependency bindings. Native AgentLoop admission, owner resume, scheduling, event waits, Delivery dispatch, tools, settlement and delayed whole-goal completion recheck the live binding and outcome.
Dependency loss before dispatch produces no model or tool effect and a denied wake. Drift after a tool or Delivery dispatch preserves unknown, non-quiescent state and is never automatically replayed.

Pending prepared and paused-scheduled wakes retry only after both step verifier and whole-goal outcome services are ready. Permanent stale, cleared or unavailable dependency states terminate the wake as denied while the paused Automation remains unclaimable.
Proactive execute decisions bind the complete wait, owner, goal, definition, native, source, event and expiry identity instead of only event sequence.
Goals now accepts the lark-calendar event-source kind already emitted by the same-release EventTriggers protocol.

limitations: This batch uses deterministic native AgentLoop, verifier, SQLite and Automations integration tests; it does not add a new real-model or browser run.
Goal, Outcome, Execution, Wake and Session databases are not one cross-database transaction; repeated fences and unknown-after-side-effect semantics provide the bounded guarantee.
WP05 remains implementing: automatic stale-assumption investigation, real external-submit readback and compensation, and a long-running production scenario remain outstanding.
failedChecks: The first root check exposed a stale assistant-goals build consumed by nine assistant-delivery scheduled-goal tests; rebuilding the package made all nine pass without changing their assertions.

The second root check exposed that a legitimate proactive coalescing decision can bind a later event in the current bounded page. The final implementation preserves full non-event identity checks, scans forward at most 32 events, and materializes only after the exact event ID, sequence and digest are observed.
